game_title: Stamina Climb – Dragon Hoard Cave Race
game_concept: A strategy race set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Stamina Climb: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Dragon Hoard Cave, repeat each round: Keep climbing while stamina > 0, deciding when to rest inside the loop. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the dwarf scout ahead. Then check the stamina value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the crystal door by solving code steps involving stamina that move the dwarf scout forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the crystal door first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Stamina Climb
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Stamina Climb' (Week 4 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Dragon Hoard Cave'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stamina changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Dragon Hoard Cave.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
